meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会根据实验需求推荐 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 协议,说明价格与周转时间,引导上传输入并完成订购流程;对目录外的定制方案,会转述给 EstiMate 做可行性评估与报价。
howto.when: 当用户提到想做蛋白表达与纯化、RNA 合成、荧光像素艺术等 Cloud Lab 支持的实验,或想查询协议价格、提交定制需求时触发。

say.text: 我要做细胞-free 的蛋白表达并纯化,该选哪个协议?
say.note: Claude 会比对目录给出推荐、价格和周期。

say.text: IVT 合成 mRNA 的价格和预计时间是多少?
say.note: Claude 会给出该协议的定价与周转时间。

say.text: 帮我用 EstiMate 给一个自定义流程做评估。
say.note: Claude 会引导你把需求转给 EstiMate。

howto.what_en: Claude recommends matching Ginkgo Cloud Lab protocols with price and turnaround, guides input upload and ordering workflow, and forwards custom requests to EstiMate for feasibility and pricing review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions running supported experiments such as protein expression, RNA synthesis, or pixel art, or wants to check protocol pricing and order services on Ginkgo Cloud Lab.

say_en.text: Which cell-free expression and purification protocol should I pick?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend options with price and turnaround.

say_en.text: What is the price and turnaround for IVT mRNA synthesis?
say_en.note: Claude will show the listed pricing and lead time.

say_en.text: Help me get a custom workflow assessed via EstiMate.
say_en.note: Claude will route the request to EstiMate.
